text:
You need a mobile app for Android and iOS that works with ChatGPT for eyewear, lets users give voice commands through Siri and Google Assistant, and returns the NLP output cleanly and reliably.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’ve spent 6 years building machine learning and NLP solutions with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and related tooling. Your project is a strong fit for the kind of assistant workflow work I’ve done: voice-triggered input, natural language processing, structured response handling, and a smooth handoff between user intent and model output.

One relevant project was a Contract clause search assistant for the legal industry. I built an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. The result was a faithfulness score of 0.91 on a 120-question lawyer-written test set, and clause lookup time dropped from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project required careful prompt design, retrieval-aware output, and dependable response formatting.

Another relevant project was a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics. I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. That system resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5. It also involved building a user-friendly conversational flow and making sure the assistant could handle real-world requests without losing context.

For your eyewear app, I would focus on a dependable conversation layer that can accept voice input through Siri and Google Assistant, pass it into ChatGPT cleanly, and return concise NLP output in a way that feels natural on mobile. I’d pay close attention to intent handling, conversation state, and response consistency so the experience is stable across both Android and iOS.

If you’d like, I can help you map the app flow and define the assistant behavior before development starts.
